items.item: Does not put a synchronous callout in a trigger or before-save context; uses an asynchronous pattern
items.evidence: "Asynchronous callout with `Queueable` and `Database.AllowsCallouts`"; "The callout would also hold up the user's save"; alternative of Platform Events/CDC

items.item: Uses a Named Credential (and External Credential) for the endpoint and authentication, with no hard-coded URL or secret
items.evidence: "Named Credential and External Credential for `https://erp.example.com`... Use `callout:ERP_Orders/api/orders`"; "Don't hardcode the URL or secrets in Apex"

items.item: Covers failure handling: retries, logging or an error record
items.evidence: "On a 5xx or timeout, re-enqueue with a capped retry count"; fields `ERP_Sync_Status__c`, `ERP_Last_Error__c`; "A scheduled job can sweep Failed or stuck-Pending orders"
